summary: New acceptance_matrix (7 criteria) for the Stripe-Spenden (donations) feature. No real Supabase test account exists, so all auth-gated /api/payments/* endpoints were verified via pytest with FastAPI app.dependency_overrides (current_user) plus module-level monkeypatching of routers.payments.require_admin / routers.payments.rest, exactly as instructed by spec_deviations. 5 new backend pytest files (24 tests total) cover tiers, checkout validation, status, webhook signature and admin confirm/double-credit/rollback. 2 named browser checks cover the two UI-facing (guest-visible) criteria; both needed the public preview URL explicitly because the local :3000 dev server does not proxy /api/* (only the ingress does) - without it the donate pages' React Query calls 404 and the test-mode hint / failed-session state never render.

checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_tiers.py
checks.evidence: GET http://localhost:8001/api/payments/tiers -> 200; 6 tiers present with exact amount_cents/lookup_key (supporter 100, bronze 500, silver 1500, gold 3000, diamond 5000, founder 10000, EUR), custom_min_cents=100, custom_max_cents=50000, test_mode=true.

checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_checkout.py
checks.evidence: No/invalid Bearer -> 401 (real server). With current_user overridden via TestClient: tier_id 'gold' -> 200, checkout_url contains 'checkout.stripe.com', session_id present; Mongo payment_transactions doc for that session has payment_status=pending, credit_status=open, amount_cents=3000, user_id matches. custom_amount_cents=777 -> 200. custom 50 -> 400, custom 60000 -> 400, no tier/amount -> 400, unknown tier_id without amount -> 400. (First run hit a transient network timeout talking to real Supabase for the invalid-bearer case; reran in isolation and in the full suite twice more - passed both times, classified flaky/network, not a bug.)

checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_status.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/payments/status/cs_test_tscheck_unknown_session -> 404. A session freshly created through the overridden checkout -> GET (unauthenticated, real server) returns 200 with payment_status='pending' and exactly the keys {session_id, status, payment_status}.

checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_webhook.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/stripe/webhook with a bogus stripe-signature header -> 400; with no signature header at all -> 400.

checks.name: test_tscheck_payments_admin.py
checks.evidence: GET admin/donations and POST .../confirm without token -> 401 (real server). With current_user + require_admin overridden/monkeypatched and routers.payments.rest replaced with a fake async callable: confirm on a tscheck paid/open fixture doc -> 200 credit_status='credited', rest called exactly once with POST /rest/v1/donations and correct user_id/amount_cents(3000)/verified_by; second confirm on the same doc -> 409; confirm on a pending-doc fixture -> 409; when the mocked rest returns status 400, confirm -> 502 and the fixture doc's credit_status reverts to 'open'. All fixture docs (session_id prefixed cs_test_tscheck_admin_...) deleted by each test after assertions; verified zero tscheck residue left in payment_transactions after the suite.

checks.name: donate-page-guest-hints
checks.evidence: On public preview /spenden: donate-page, donate-test-mode-hint and donate-login-link all visible for a guest. /spenden?abgebrochen=1 shows donate-cancelled-hint. (Needed the explicit public-preview URL - localhost:3000 proxy returns 404 for /api/payments/tiers so the test-mode hint never mounts locally; this is a dev-proxy limitation, not an app bug, confirmed by the same endpoint returning 200 through the public preview ingress.)

checks.name: donate-thanks-invalid-session
checks.evidence: /spende-danke?session_id=cs_nope eventually shows donate-thanks-failed (after React Query's retry/backoff on the 404 status call - needed a 20s assertion timeout, not 5s) with a retry link href='/spenden'. /spende-danke with no session_id param also shows donate-thanks-failed.

notes: All 7 acceptance_matrix criteria covered 1:1 (5 backend test files for the 5 API-bearing criteria, 2 browser checks for the 2 guest-visible UI criteria); matrix did not exceed the 8-item threshold.

Logged-in UI flows (tier selection -> Stripe redirect, admin StripeDonationsAdmin confirm list) were intentionally NOT browser-tested per spec_deviations (no Supabase test account) - fully covered instead via the dependency-override backend tests above.

Donation UI being hidden in the native app (isNativeApp) was not re-verified as a separate criterion - it is not in the acceptance_matrix and spec_deviations explicitly calls it out as intentional, not a gap.
No bugs found. The only friction was environmental: local :3000 doesn't proxy /api/* (ingress-only), requiring both browser checks to target the public preview URL explicitly.
